subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Should #43661 remain open as the concrete P0 Telegram satellite under #101863, or should maintainers split the remaining Telegram send-idempotency and poisoned-session recovery work into a narrower canonical issue?
rationale: Current main has partial mitigations, but the final contract crosses run lifecycle, outbound delivery, Telegram adapter capability, restart recovery, and UX recovery semantics.

options.title: Keep as #101863 satellite
options.body: Keep #43661 open and use it as concrete production evidence while #101863 tracks the broader lifecycle contract and linked PRs land smaller pieces.

options.title: Split Telegram recovery
options.body: Create or designate a narrower canonical issue for Telegram exact-send reconciliation plus pending-final-delivery restart replay, then link #43661 as source evidence.

options.title: Close after full proof
options.body: Close #43661 only after current main or a shipped release demonstrates no duplicate Telegram sends and no manual poisoned-session recovery for the reported path.

recommendation.title: Keep as #101863 satellite
recommendation.body: Keep #43661 open and use it as concrete production evidence while #101863 tracks the broader lifecycle contract and linked PRs land smaller pieces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current live assignee and has recent history on the exact inspected recovery and adapter surfaces.
